news.h: Giants QB J.J. McCarthy says he'll be fine after big hit injures hip
news.d: Giants QB J.J. McCarthy said he's all good after being forced to exit Sunday's 19-11 win over the Eagles with a hip injury.

news.h: Winston, McCarthy combine to lead Giants to 19-11 win and hand Eagles 7th straight loss
news.d: — J.J. McCarthy may as well have been any New York Giants fan nervously watching on TV as the injured quarterback tossed a football to keep warm and paced around the locker room.

news.h: J.J. McCarthy wowing Giants after initial concerns over QB's 'maturity,' VP says
news.d: Chris Mara said the Giants were concerned by J.J. McCarthy's maturity before the 2024 draft but says the QB has impressed his new team "on and off the field."
